request:

风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-arch58）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['ENG broadcast camera', 'scan lines']）：Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，有噪点和色彩偏移，手持。昏暗的机房里一排排显示器接连亮起，筋疲力尽、浑身湿透的技术员举起手臂欢呼、互相拥抱。环境声：失真的欢呼声和掌声。
情绪：euphoric, exhausted, relieved
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium wide shot, handheld news camera with jerky reframing
景深与虚实：Archival softness, the bright monitors blooming.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival 2058 news footage: in a dark control room beside the flooded hall, rows of monitors flicker and light up one after another; exhausted technicians in wet clothes raise their arms and hug. Blocking lock: rows of monitors recede from frame left to the background; technicians stand at frame right and centre, some raising their arms.
Picture 2: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation (location reference; role: location reference). A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：distorted cheering, clapping, a monitor power-up whine

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 8.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium wide shot, handheld ENG broadcast camera with one small, jerky reframing from the rows of monitors at frame left to the technicians at frame right and centre, the framing staying medium wide and moving abruptly, then settling; the 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris hunts as the screens flare. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. At the start the rows of monitors recede from frame left into the background, the nearest monitor housing a dark edge in the foreground at frame left; technicians stand at frame right and centre in soaked clothes, some with arms half raised, lit by floodlight glare and emergency strobe light. Start: one monitor at the far left flickers, a faint scan line rolling across its face, then catches and burns pale blue-white. Middle: the screens light up one after another from frame left toward the background, the glow blooming through the room and flaring in the auto iris, while the technicians lift their heads and turn toward the bank, wet hair plastered to their foreheads. End: the technicians at frame right and centre throw both arms up and pull each other into wet, exhausted hugs, mouths open in a cheer, their faces and raised hands lit hard by the monitors. Mood: euphoric, exhausted, relieved. Blur: archival softness overall, the bright monitor faces blooming into halos and the background dissolving into murk, while the raised arms and wet faces at frame right and centre stay legible. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Distorted cheering and applause, a monitor power-up whine, electrical hum from the monitor bank, wet shoes shifting on concrete, exhausted breathing; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
